onboarding.opening: Before we begin — tell me a little about your garden.
onboarding.privacyBody:
Gina Haya respects your privacy.

We collect information about your garden — location, soil type, and plants — solely to show you a personalised biodynamic calendar and provide smart advice.

We never sell your data to third parties. Your data is encrypted and secured on Supabase servers in the European Union.

You can delete all your data at any time from account settings. Using the service constitutes acceptance of our Privacy Policy.
